change_control.reason: author decision: exclude KNN from the formal comparison

dataset_partition: official TSB-AD Tuning/Eval split from Liu and Paparrizos (2024)
selection_policy: Baselines use paper-reported, author-released, or official TSB-AD Tuning-selected parameters without additional search. When no matching parameters exist, a documented stability default is frozen before Eval. STAGE is tuned only on official TSB-AD Tuning, with the same search budget for every subset; Eval metrics never affect selection.

stage_tuning_policy.granularity: one frozen configuration per benchmark subset; never per Eval series

execution_order: baselines first, with PaAno first on the GPU queue; STAGE only after all admitted baselines
storage_policy: full-precision metrics only; no checkpoint or score array
runtime_policy: main-run timings are diagnostic and paper-ineligible; Average Inference Time is reported only after a separate exclusive, identical-hardware rerun
